ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 1:6 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, with white pixels primarily concentrated in linear features and along the distal edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base pigmentation consists of contiguous low-intensity black pixels. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory fitted to the trailing edge pixels of both lobes, sweeping from the central notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of intersecting, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering approximately 75% of the visible fluke surface, appearing as bright white streaks against the dark background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake-mark scarring across both lobes; numerous irregular notches and loss of material along the trailing edge boundary.
